publicationOwner.title: Publication proposals and preparation
publicationOwner.intro: Review private proposals and adopt them into Funding drafts before examining each service. Preparation never authorizes delivery.
publicationOwner.return: Return to the dossier's publication tracking
publicationOwner.forbidden: Your account cannot access this dossier.

title: Preflight
intro: Review the proposals Preflight has prepared for Funding.
authority: These preparations require review. Business decisions remain in Funding; a proposal does not constitute approval.
disabled: Preflight reception is not configured for this environment yet.
unavailable: Proposals are currently unavailable. You can refresh or open the Preflight console.
forbidden: Your account does not have access to Preflight proposals.
empty: No proposals are available for Funding in Preflight.

workspace.subtitle: Intelligent service preparation
workspace.intro: Preflight prepares content and checks from recorded commitments. You review, approve and deliver services in Funding, according to its business rules.
workspace.unlinkedProposal: This proposal is available in Preflight. Its link to a Funding service has not been verified yet; decisions and deliveries remain in the Funding dossiers.

rehearsal.evidenceIntro: Inspect confirmed exchanges between Funding and Preflight. These records describe preparation and proposal retrieval; service-delivery evidence remains in Funding.
rehearsal.title: Follow the Funding → Preflight bridge
rehearsal.intro: Start a synthetic case and follow its actual journey between the two applications. Indicators reflect steps confirmed by the servers.
rehearsal.disabled: The test journey is disabled for this environment.
rehearsal.readOnly: You can view the journeys. An operator or owner role is required to start a test.
rehearsal.paused: Automatic tracking is paused after two minutes. Refresh to check for new states.
rehearsal.uncertain: Receipt of this delivery is not confirmed yet. Retrying first checks for the existing mission and keeps the same identifier.
rehearsal.waitingInput: Preflight is waiting for information. This scenario checks that the journey reports the blocker and stops at this step.
rehearsal.lastConfirmed: Indicators show the last confirmed states. No new state has been verified.
rehearsal.runError: The journey encountered a problem. Reference:
rehearsal.reviewRequired: The proposal is available in Funding for human review. It does not constitute business approval.

errors.notFound: This journey is not available to your account. Refresh to check whether it was created.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot access this test operation.
errors.conflict: The journey changed or this identifier belongs to a different request. Refresh before continuing.
errors.commandUnavailable: The outcome of this request is not confirmed. Refresh tracking or retry with the same identifier.
errors.observationUnavailable: Tracking is temporarily unavailable. You can refresh it manually.

preparations.title: OpenG7 Preflight preparations
preparations.authority: Proposed work for review. Decisions and publication remain under Funding Platform’s authority.
preparations.disabled: The Preflight connector is disabled. This Funding instance does not send work to Preflight.
preparations.configured: Connector configured. This does not confirm the remote service’s current availability.
preparations.empty: No Preflight preparation is stored for this dossier. Results will appear after worker processing.

errors.forbidden: Your session cannot access these preparations. Sign in again with authorized access.
errors.unavailable: Preparations are temporarily unavailable. You can retry without modifying the dossier.
